description: A blank death_country is treated as one ordinary group, and shares are computed within it.

b.request: For each manager in `manager_award` with a matching `player` record, count their award rows and divide by the total award rows for matched managers with the same non-NULL `death_country`, treating blank as its own country group; return manager ID, death country, award count, and unrounded share for the top 10 managers by share descending, with missing shares last
b.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), shares AS (SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;

c.request: For managers in `manager_award` who match a `player` record on `player_id`, count each manager's awards by their `death_country` (NULL death countries drop out), and show what share of all the awards for managers with that same death country each one accounts for. Give manager id, death country, award count and share, top 10 by share (highest first, missing last), unrounded. A blank death_country is treated as one ordinary group, and shares are computed within it.
c.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), shares AS (SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, manager_id LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each manager in `manager_award` who matches a `player` record on `player_id`, count their award rows by manager and the player's `death_country`. Managers with a NULL death country drop out. Keep managers whose death country is an empty string, and treat that blank as a death-country group of its own. Then show each manager's award count as a share of the total awards for all managers with the same death country. List manager id, death country, award count and share, sorted by share from highest to lowest (missing last). Show the top 10, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

d.request: For managers in `manager_award` who match a `player` record on `player_id`, count each manager’s awards by `death_country`. Exclude NULL death countries, but treat blank `death_country` values as one ordinary group and calculate shares within that group. Show manager ID, death country, award count, and unrounded share of all awards for managers with the same death country. Return the top 10 by share, highest first, with missing shares last.
d.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), shares AS (SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;
